title: Career roadmap · Registrar Assistant
summary: Build strong foundations in corporate secretarial practice, company law, governance, documentation and statutory filings, then progress into corporate secretarial, compliance and governance roles.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 3-year B.Com beginning in 2026. Use the final year for company-secretarial internships, statutory filing practice, corporate-law knowledge and professional qualification preparation. If a 4-year honours pathway is available, use the additional year for advanced governance, compliance, corporate law and professional training.

about.label: Course alignment
about.text: Registrar Assistant is directly aligned with the B.Com – Corporate Secretaryship pathway.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build knowledge of company law, corporate records, board procedures, statutory filings, governance and business communication.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in company secretarial practice, corporate compliance, governance, regulatory filings or legal operations.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward Senior Secretarial Executive, Secretarial Officer, Compliance Officer or Assistant Company Secretary roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine governance expertise with regulatory technology, digital filings, compliance automation, risk and board governance.

Future corporate-secretarial professionals should combine company-law expertise with digital filings, RegTech, compliance automation, data governance, risk management, ESG reporting and board-level governance. The strongest professionals will move from administrative filing work toward advising organisations on governance, compliance and regulatory risk.
